stonecutter.name: Stonecutter
stonecutter.desc: Cuts stone blocks into stairs, slabs, walls and bricks one for one.

axle.name: Wooden Axle
axle.desc: Carries turning power from a windmill or waterwheel to a millstone or sawmill.

windmill.name: Windmill Sails
windmill.desc: Place on the side of a block high up in open air. Its axle turns machines.

waterwheel.name: Waterwheel
waterwheel.desc: Place beside flowing water. Its axle turns machines.

millstone.name: Millstone
millstone.desc: Grinds ore into two crushed ores, wheat into flour, gravel into sand. Needs a turning axle. Hoppers can feed it and take from it.

sawmill.name: Sawmill
sawmill.desc: Saws logs into six planks. Needs a turning axle.

conveyor.name: Conveyor Belt
conveyor.desc: Lay them in a line; turn one with an axle and the whole run carries things the way it was laid. At the end it fills a chest, hopper, furnace or machine.

crusher.name: Crusher
crusher.desc: Crushes every ore into two (sometimes three, with its builder's Smithing). Needs strong turning: an axle from a windmill or waterwheel.

waystone.name: Waystone
waystone.desc: Use a waystone to attune to it, and to travel to any other you're attuned to (a level or two of experience, by how far). Every village has one.

harvester.name: Harvester
harvester.desc: Turned by an axle, it reaps every ripe crop and berry bush within 4 blocks, replants, and fills a chest or hopper beside it.

scaffolding.name: Scaffolding
scaffolding.desc: Climb it like a ladder; sneak to go down through it.

slime_block.name: Slime Block
slime_block.desc: Bounces you back up. Sneak to land softly.

honey_block.name: Honey Block
honey_block.desc: Sticky: slows you down and softens falls.

ender_chest.name: Ender Chest
ender_chest.desc: Your own private chest. Every ender chest opens onto the same 27 slots.

party_chest.name: Party Chest
party_chest.desc: Every party chest in the world opens onto the same 27 slots, for everyone playing.

smithing_table.name: Smithing Table
smithing_table.desc: Upgrades diamond gear with a cinderite shard, and copper gear to bronze with a tin ingot.

loom.name: Loom
loom.desc: Recolours wool, carpet, concrete powder, terracotta and glass in bulk: eight blocks per dye.

cartography_table.name: Cartography Table
cartography_table.desc: A mapmaker's desk. Maps come in a later update.

fletching_table.name: Fletching Table
fletching_table.desc: Fletches arrows: flint and feathers make twice the arrows of a crafting table.

composter.name: Composter
composter.desc: Fill it with plants. When it is full, use it again for bone meal.

anvil.name: Anvil
anvil.desc: Repairs a tool with its own material, or joins two worn tools. Wears out with use.

chipped_anvil.name: Chipped Anvil
chipped_anvil.desc: Repairs a tool with its own material, or joins two worn tools. Wears out with use.

damaged_anvil.name: Damaged Anvil
damaged_anvil.desc: Repairs a tool with its own material, or joins two worn tools. Wears out with use.

grindstone.name: Grindstone
grindstone.desc: Joins two worn tools of the same kind into one, a little better than new.

item_frame.name: Item Frame
item_frame.desc: Hang it on a wall and put an item in it. Use again to turn the item.

glow_item_frame.name: Glow Item Frame
glow_item_frame.desc: An item frame whose item glows in the dark.

weapon_rack.name: Weapon Rack
weapon_rack.desc: Stand it on the floor or hang it on a wall, then rest up to three weapons, tools or shields on it.

cake.name: Cake
cake.desc: Place it, then eat it a slice at a time.

redstone_torch.name: Redstone Torch
redstone_torch.desc: Always on — until the block it hangs on is powered. Then it goes out.

lever.name: Lever
lever.desc: On and off. Goes on floors, ceilings and walls.

repeater.name: Redstone Repeater
repeater.desc: Passes a signal on at full strength, one way only. Use it to set a delay of 1-4 ticks.

comparator.name: Redstone Comparator
comparator.desc: Compares the signal behind it with the ones at its sides, or reads how full a container is. Use it to switch to subtract.

observer.name: Observer
observer.desc: Sends a short pulse out of its back when the block in front of its face changes.

piston.name: Piston
piston.desc: Pushes up to 12 blocks when powered.

sticky_piston.name: Sticky Piston
sticky_piston.desc: Pushes, and pulls the block back when the power goes.

dispenser.name: Dispenser
dispenser.desc: Powered: shoots arrows, pours buckets, uses bone meal, lights TNT, sets down carts and boats.

dropper.name: Dropper
dropper.desc: Powered: drops an item, or passes it into the container in front.

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.desc: Pulls items from above and passes them on through its spout. Redstone locks it.

daylight_detector.name: Daylight Detector
daylight_detector.desc: Gives a signal in daylight. Use it to invert it for night.

rain_detector.name: Rain Detector
rain_detector.desc: Gives a signal while rain or snow falls on it. Use it to invert it.

command_block.name: Command Block
command_block.desc: Runs a command when powered by redstone. Use it to set the command (creative).

target.name: Target
target.desc: Hit it with an arrow: the nearer the middle, the stronger the signal.

copper_bulb.name: Copper Bulb
copper_bulb.desc: Toggles on or off each time it is powered.

tripwire_hook.name: Tripwire Hook
tripwire_hook.desc: Two hooks facing each other with string between them: walking through sends a signal.

rail.name: Rail
rail.desc: Lay track for minecarts. Rails join up, climb slopes and turn corners on their own.

powered_rail.name: Powered Rail
powered_rail.desc: Powered: speeds carts up. Unpowered: stops them.

detector_rail.name: Detector Rail
detector_rail.desc: Sends a signal while a cart is on it.

activator_rail.name: Activator Rail
activator_rail.desc: Powered: tips riders out, lights TNT carts, locks hopper carts.

enchanting_table.name: Enchanting Table
enchanting_table.desc: Lapis and your levels: three offers. Bookshelves two blocks around it make them stronger.

rope.name: Rope
rope.desc: Use it on a ledge, a ceiling or another rope: it hangs down to the ground. Climb it like a ladder.

sleeping_bag.name: Sleeping Bag
sleeping_bag.desc: Lay it down and sleep anywhere. Your spawn for that night only.

brewing_stand.name: Brewing Stand
brewing_stand.desc: Up to three bottles, an ingredient on top, cinder powder to burn.

bronze_ingot.name: Bronze Ingot
bronze_ingot.desc: Three parts copper, one part tin.

mese_crystal.name: Mese Crystal
mese_crystal.desc: A crystal that hums faintly. Makes a bright lamp.

straw.name: Straw
straw.desc: Cut from tall grass. Makes thatch, hay and cob.

flour.name: Flour
flour.desc: Ground at a millstone. Bake it in a furnace.

crushed_iron.name: Crushed Iron Ore
crushed_iron.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A millstone makes two from every ore.

crushed_gold.name: Crushed Gold Ore
crushed_gold.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A millstone makes two from every ore.

crushed_copper.name: Crushed Copper Ore
crushed_copper.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A millstone makes two from every ore.

crushed_tin.name: Crushed Tin Ore
crushed_tin.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A millstone makes two from every ore.

cinder_core.name: Cinder Core
cinder_core.desc: Still warm. Pulses like a heartbeat.

golden_apple.name: Golden Apple
golden_apple.desc: Heals, then keeps healing for a while.

glow_berries.name: Glow Berries
glow_berries.desc: Plant on a cave ceiling to grow glowing vines.

honey_bottle.name: Honey Bottle
honey_bottle.desc: Sweet. Cures poison, even at full health.

milk_bucket.name: Milk Bucket
milk_bucket.desc: Drink to wash away frost and burning.

cocoa_beans.name: Cocoa Beans
cocoa_beans.desc: Plant on the side of a jungle log.

bone_meal.name: Bone Meal
bone_meal.desc: Use on crops, saplings and grass to make them grow.

honeycomb.name: Honeycomb
honeycomb.desc: Shear it from a full bee nest or hive.

glass_bottle.name: Glass Bottle
glass_bottle.desc: Use it at water (or a cauldron) to fill it.

redstone.name: Redstone Dust
redstone.desc: Lay it on the ground to carry power. Each block of dust loses a little.

we_wand.name: WorldEdit Wand
we_wand.desc: Left click: corner 1. Right click: corner 2. Then //set, //replace, //copy... (/help)

death_compass.name: Death Compass
death_compass.desc: Points to your grave. Open the grave to get everything back.

heart_crystal.name: Heart Crystal
heart_crystal.desc: A boss's heart, crystallised. Use it for one more heart that stays (up to ten).

vigor_charm.name: Charm of Vigor
vigor_charm.desc: Worn on the belt: two more hearts.

ember_charm.name: Ember Charm
ember_charm.desc: Worn on the belt: fire and lava hurt half as much.

tide_charm.name: Tide Charm
tide_charm.desc: Worn on the belt: your breath lasts four times as long under water.

feather_charm.name: Feather Charm
feather_charm.desc: Worn on the belt: falls hurt half as much.

minecart.name: Minecart
minecart.desc: Set it on a rail and climb in. Powered rails speed it up.

chest_minecart.name: Minecart with Chest
chest_minecart.desc: A rolling chest. Hoppers can fill and empty it.

hopper_minecart.name: Minecart with Hopper
hopper_minecart.desc: Picks up items it rolls under or over. Locked on a powered activator rail.

furnace_minecart.name: Minecart with Furnace
furnace_minecart.desc: Feed it coal and it pushes itself (and the carts in front of it).

armor_stand.name: Armor Stand
armor_stand.desc: Set it down and dress it: use armour or a weapon on it. Sneak + use with an empty hand to change its pose.

tnt_minecart.name: Minecart with TNT
tnt_minecart.desc: Goes off when it rolls over a powered activator rail.

bow.name: Bow
bow.desc: Hold use to draw, let go to shoot. Needs arrows.

compass.name: Compass
compass.desc: Points home, to your spawn point.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.desc: Hold use to look through it.

leather_helmet.name: Leather Helmet
leather_helmet.desc: Full set: Ranger's Ease (a little quicker on your feet, and falls hurt a quarter less)

leather_chestplate.name: Leather Chestplate
leather_chestplate.desc: Full set: Ranger's Ease (a little quicker on your feet, and falls hurt a quarter less)

leather_leggings.name: Leather Leggings
leather_leggings.desc: Full set: Ranger's Ease (a little quicker on your feet, and falls hurt a quarter less)

leather_boots.name: Leather Boots
leather_boots.desc: Full set: Ranger's Ease (a little quicker on your feet, and falls hurt a quarter less)

copper_helmet.name: Copper Helmet
copper_helmet.desc: Full set: Copper Hum (mana comes back a fifth faster)

copper_chestplate.name: Copper Chestplate
copper_chestplate.desc: Full set: Copper Hum (mana comes back a fifth faster)

copper_leggings.name: Copper Leggings
copper_leggings.desc: Full set: Copper Hum (mana comes back a fifth faster)

copper_boots.name: Copper Boots
copper_boots.desc: Full set: Copper Hum (mana comes back a fifth faster)

bronze_helmet.name: Bronze Helmet
bronze_helmet.desc: Full set: Bulwark (4% less harm, and half the knockback)

bronze_chestplate.name: Bronze Chestplate
bronze_chestplate.desc: Full set: Bulwark (4% less harm, and half the knockback)

bronze_leggings.name: Bronze Leggings
bronze_leggings.desc: Full set: Bulwark (4% less harm, and half the knockback)

bronze_boots.name: Bronze Boots
bronze_boots.desc: Full set: Bulwark (4% less harm, and half the knockback)

iron_helmet.name: Iron Helmet
iron_helmet.desc: Full set: Ironclad (5% less harm, and 40% less knockback)

iron_chestplate.name: Iron Chestplate
iron_chestplate.desc: Full set: Ironclad (5% less harm, and 40% less knockback)

iron_leggings.name: Iron Leggings
iron_leggings.desc: Full set: Ironclad (5% less harm, and 40% less knockback)

iron_boots.name: Iron Boots
iron_boots.desc: Full set: Ironclad (5% less harm, and 40% less knockback)

gold_helmet.name: Golden Helmet
gold_helmet.desc: Full set: Gilded (a fifth more experience from everything)

gold_chestplate.name: Golden Chestplate
gold_chestplate.desc: Full set: Gilded (a fifth more experience from everything)

gold_leggings.name: Golden Leggings
gold_leggings.desc: Full set: Gilded (a fifth more experience from everything)

gold_boots.name: Golden Boots
gold_boots.desc: Full set: Gilded (a fifth more experience from everything)

diamond_helmet.name: Diamond Helmet
diamond_helmet.desc: Full set: Brilliance (8% less harm, and the set wears a third slower)

diamond_chestplate.name: Diamond Chestplate
diamond_chestplate.desc: Full set: Brilliance (8% less harm, and the set wears a third slower)

diamond_leggings.name: Diamond Leggings
diamond_leggings.desc: Full set: Brilliance (8% less harm, and the set wears a third slower)

diamond_boots.name: Diamond Boots
diamond_boots.desc: Full set: Brilliance (8% less harm, and the set wears a third slower)

cinderite_helmet.name: Cinderite Helmet
cinderite_helmet.desc: Full set: Emberheart (fire and lava hurt half as much and flames die quickly; 8% less harm)

cinderite_chestplate.name: Cinderite Chestplate
cinderite_chestplate.desc: Full set: Emberheart (fire and lava hurt half as much and flames die quickly; 8% less harm)

cinderite_leggings.name: Cinderite Leggings
cinderite_leggings.desc: Full set: Emberheart (fire and lava hurt half as much and flames die quickly; 8% less harm)

cinderite_boots.name: Cinderite Boots
cinderite_boots.desc: Full set: Emberheart (fire and lava hurt half as much and flames die quickly; 8% less harm)

rowboat.name: Rowboat
rowboat.desc: Place on water. Use to climb in; sneak to get out.

sailboat.name: Sailboat
sailboat.desc: Catches the wind — fastest with the wind across or behind you. W/S set the sail, A/D steer.

leather_backpack.name: Leather Backpack
leather_backpack.desc: Wear it in the backpack slot for 9 extra slots.

reinforced_backpack.name: Reinforced Backpack
reinforced_backpack.desc: Wear it in the backpack slot for 18 extra slots.

ember_effigy.name: Ember Effigy
ember_effigy.desc: Place on the ground at night to summon the Cinder Golem.

cinderite_shard.name: Cinderite Shard
cinderite_shard.desc: Mined in the Ember Depths. Forged into fire-proof gear.

aether_crystal.name: Aether Crystal
aether_crystal.desc: Hums with weightless light. Found in the Skylands.

ember_igniter.name: Ember Igniter
ember_igniter.desc: Use on an obsidian frame to open a portal to the Ember Depths.

pocket_key.name: Pocket Key
pocket_key.desc: Use to step into your personal pocket dimension, and again to return.

frost_shard.name: Frost Shard
frost_shard.desc: Found in snowy peaks. Cold to the touch.

frostbite_dagger.name: Frostbite Dagger
frostbite_dagger.desc: Frost element. Slows foes. Cinder Golems take double damage.

ink_sac.name: Ink Sac
ink_sac.desc: Black dye, and ink for writing.

glow_ink_sac.name: Glow Ink Sac
glow_ink_sac.desc: Makes the writing on signs glow.

turtle_scute.name: Turtle Scute
turtle_scute.desc: Shed by young turtles as they grow up.

goat_horn.name: Goat Horn
goat_horn.desc: Knocked off when a goat rams something hard.

venom_sac.name: Venom Sac
venom_sac.desc: From snakes, scorpions and cave spiders.

ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
ectoplasm.desc: Cold to the touch. Left behind by a wraith.

cinder_rod.name: Cinder Rod
cinder_rod.desc: Still warm. Burns a long while.

ogre_club.name: Ogre Club
ogre_club.desc: Heavy. Hits hard and knocks things flying.

hex_flask.name: Hex Flask
hex_flask.desc: A bog witch's brew. Throw it: poison and slowness.

saddle.name: Saddle
saddle.desc: Put it on a tamed horse, camel, bear or big cat, then ride.

sailing_ship.name: Sailing Ship
sailing_ship.desc: A ship with a deck to walk on. Use it to climb aboard; use the wheel to sail.

fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing_rod.desc: Use to cast; use again to reel in. When the float ducks under, reel in quick.

silver_helmet.name: Silver Helmet
silver_helmet.desc: Full set: Moonsilver (the undead take a quarter more from your blows; 4% less harm)

silver_chestplate.name: Silver Chestplate
silver_chestplate.desc: Full set: Moonsilver (the undead take a quarter more from your blows; 4% less harm)

silver_leggings.name: Silver Leggings
silver_leggings.desc: Full set: Moonsilver (the undead take a quarter more from your blows; 4% less harm)

silver_boots.name: Silver Boots
silver_boots.desc: Full set: Moonsilver (the undead take a quarter more from your blows; 4% less harm)

steel_helmet.name: Steel Helmet
steel_helmet.desc: Full set: Steelguard (7% less harm, blows 5% harder, 40% less knockback)

steel_chestplate.name: Steel Chestplate
steel_chestplate.desc: Full set: Steelguard (7% less harm, blows 5% harder, 40% less knockback)

steel_leggings.name: Steel Leggings
steel_leggings.desc: Full set: Steelguard (7% less harm, blows 5% harder, 40% less knockback)

steel_boots.name: Steel Boots
steel_boots.desc: Full set: Steelguard (7% less harm, blows 5% harder, 40% less knockback)

mithril_helmet.name: Mithril Helmet
mithril_helmet.desc: Full set: Featherlight (8% quicker on your feet, 9% less harm, falls hurt half)

mithril_chestplate.name: Mithril Chestplate
mithril_chestplate.desc: Full set: Featherlight (8% quicker on your feet, 9% less harm, falls hurt half)

mithril_leggings.name: Mithril Leggings
mithril_leggings.desc: Full set: Featherlight (8% quicker on your feet, 9% less harm, falls hurt half)

mithril_boots.name: Mithril Boots
mithril_boots.desc: Full set: Featherlight (8% quicker on your feet, 9% less harm, falls hurt half)

adamantite_helmet.name: Adamantite Helmet
adamantite_helmet.desc: Full set: Unbreakable (12% less harm, no knockback, and the set wears half as fast)

adamantite_chestplate.name: Adamantite Chestplate
adamantite_chestplate.desc: Full set: Unbreakable (12% less harm, no knockback, and the set wears half as fast)

adamantite_leggings.name: Adamantite Leggings
adamantite_leggings.desc: Full set: Unbreakable (12% less harm, no knockback, and the set wears half as fast)

adamantite_boots.name: Adamantite Boots
adamantite_boots.desc: Full set: Unbreakable (12% less harm, no knockback, and the set wears half as fast)

steel_blend.name: Steel Blend
steel_blend.desc: Iron and coal, ready for the furnace.

empty_map.name: Empty Map
empty_map.desc: Use it to start a map of where you stand.

filled_map.name: Map
filled_map.desc: Fills in as you explore while you hold it.

ale_mug.name: Mug of Ale
ale_mug.desc: Foamy, brown and very welcome after a long road.

tome_firebolt.name: Tome: Firebolt
tome_firebolt.desc: A bolt of fire that sets things alight. (Magic 1)

tome_frost.name: Tome: Frost Shard
tome_frost.desc: A shard of ice that slows what it hits. (Magic 1)

tome_light.name: Tome: Witchlight
tome_light.desc: A floating light that follows you about for two minutes. (Magic 3)

tome_levitate.name: Tome: Levitate
tome_levitate.desc: Float on the air for a while: jump to rise, sneak to sink. (Magic 10)

tome_stoneskin.name: Tome: Stoneskin
tome_stoneskin.desc: Your skin hardens like stone: a third less harm, and you hardly get knocked back, for a minute. (Magic 12)

tome_blink.name: Tome: Blink
tome_blink.desc: Step through space to where you look. (Magic 15)

tome_familiar.name: Tome: Spirit Wolf
tome_familiar.desc: Calls a spirit wolf to fight at your side for a while. (Magic 18)

tome_ward.name: Tome: Ward
tome_ward.desc: A shield of light that soaks up harm for a while. (Magic 20)

apprentice_staff.name: Apprentice Staff
apprentice_staff.desc: Use to cast your spell · G to change spell

ruby_staff.name: Ruby Staff
ruby_staff.desc: Use to cast your spell · G to change spell

sapphire_staff.name: Sapphire Staff
sapphire_staff.desc: Use to cast your spell · G to change spell

mithril_staff.name: Mithril Staff
mithril_staff.desc: Use to cast your spell · G to change spell

realm_fragment.name: Realm Fragment
realm_fragment.desc: A shard of his realm, warm and humming. The rift wants it.

watcher_blade.name: Watcher's Blade
watcher_blade.desc: Taken from the one who watched. Bites the undead.

rift_staff.name: Rift Staff
rift_staff.desc: Use to cast your spell · G to change spell

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.desc: Hard as steel and light as leather.

dragonscale_helmet.name: Dragonscale Helmet
dragonscale_helmet.desc: Full set: Wyrmblood (10% less harm, fire hurts half, and wounds slowly close)

dragonscale_chestplate.name: Dragonscale Chestplate
dragonscale_chestplate.desc: Full set: Wyrmblood (10% less harm, fire hurts half, and wounds slowly close)

dragonscale_leggings.name: Dragonscale Leggings
dragonscale_leggings.desc: Full set: Wyrmblood (10% less harm, fire hurts half, and wounds slowly close)

dragonscale_boots.name: Dragonscale Boots
dragonscale_boots.desc: Full set: Wyrmblood (10% less harm, fire hurts half, and wounds slowly close)

whistle.name: Whistle
whistle.desc: Use it (or press H) to call your companions: your mounts and pets.

minotaur_horn.name: Minotaur Horn
minotaur_horn.desc: A trophy from the heart of the Labyrinth.

lore_sky_islands.name: Old Book: Of Islands in the Sky

lore_schools.name: Old Book: On the Schools of Magic

lore_miner.name: Old Book: A Miner's Last Entry

lore_desert.name: Old Book: The Sands Keep Secrets

lore_crust.name: Old Book: Of the Stacked Worlds

lore_end.name: Old Book: The End of All Roads

enchanted_book.name: Enchanted Book
enchanted_book.desc: Put it on gear at an anvil, with some of your levels.

experience_bottle.name: Bottle o' Enchanting
experience_bottle.desc: Use to break it open: a little experience pours out.

cinder_powder.name: Cinder Powder
cinder_powder.desc: Keeps a brewing stand burning (20 brews), or brews Strength.

fermented_spider_eye.name: Fermented Spider Eye
fermented_spider_eye.desc: Turns a potion to its opposite.

golden_carrot.name: Golden Carrot
golden_carrot.desc: Brews Night Vision. Good eating, too.

potion_turtle_strong.name: Potion of the Turtle Master II

splash_potion_turtle.name: Splash Potion of the Turtle Master

splash_potion_turtle_long.name: Splash Potion of the Turtle Master

splash_potion_turtle_strong.name: Splash Potion of the Turtle Master II

swet_ball.name: Swet Ball
swet_ball.desc: Sticky. Works like a slime ball.

gust_puff.name: Gust Puff
gust_puff.desc: Use it for one great leap into the air (and a gentle way down).

grappling_hook.name: Grappling Hook
grappling_hook.desc: Throw it at a ledge, a wall or a ceiling: it catches and a rope drops to the ground. Climb up, then use the hook or its rope to take it back.

campfire_kit.name: Campfire Kit
campfire_kit.desc: A campfire you carry. Set it down anywhere; sneak and use it with an empty hand to pack it up again.

explorer_backpack.name: Explorer's Backpack
explorer_backpack.desc: Wear it in the backpack slot for 27 extra slots, and straps for your sleeping bag, a campfire and your grappling hook. What you carry shows on it.

ender_pearl.name: Ender Pearl
ender_pearl.desc: Throw it, and you are wherever it lands. It stings a little.

ender_eye.name: Eye of Ender
ender_eye.desc: Throw it and follow it: it flies towards the nearest stronghold. Set one in each frame round a stronghold's portal to open it.

chorus_fruit.name: Chorus Fruit
chorus_fruit.desc: Eat it and you find yourself somewhere nearby, suddenly. Restores a little health.

elytra.name: Elytra
elytra.desc: Wear them in the cape slot. Jump while falling to spread them and glide; look down to dive, up to climb. A gust puff in flight is a boost.

echo_shard.name: Echo Shard
echo_shard.desc: It hums with every sound around it. Found in the Ancient Cities.

echo_charm.name: Echo Charm
echo_charm.desc: Worn on the belt: your steps make no sound the sculk can hear.

tome_missiles.name: Tome: Arcane Missiles
tome_missiles.desc: Three bolts of pure magic that seek out the nearest foe in front of you. (Magic 8)

tome_regrowth.name: Tome: Regrowth
tome_regrowth.desc: You and everyone near you heal over the next ten seconds. (Magic 22)

tome_haste.name: Tome: Haste
tome_haste.desc: Quick feet and a light step for forty seconds. (Magic 25)

tome_fireball.name: Tome: Fireball
tome_fireball.desc: A ball of fire that bursts where it lands, burning all around. (Magic 28)

tome_icenova.name: Tome: Ice Nova
tome_icenova.desc: A ring of frost bursts out from you, hurting and slowing every foe nearby. (Magic 35)

tome_guardian.name: Tome: Stone Guardian
tome_guardian.desc: Raises a guardian of stone to fight beside you for a minute. (Magic 40)

pyromancer_helmet.name: Pyromancer Hat

rice.name: Rice
rice.desc: Plant on farmland beside water. Cook it in a furnace.

garden_salad.name: Garden Salad
garden_salad.desc: Fresh. Keeps healing for a moment.

vegetable_stew.name: Vegetable Stew
vegetable_stew.desc: Hearty. Keeps healing for a while.

sushi.name: Sushi
sushi.desc: You breathe a little longer under water after.

stuffed_pepper.name: Stuffed Pepper
stuffed_pepper.desc: So hot that fire hardly touches you for a while.

strawberry_tart.name: Strawberry Tart
strawberry_tart.desc: Sweet. A spring in your step after.

pizza.name: Pizza
pizza.desc: A feast. You feel strong after.

watering_can.name: Watering Can
watering_can.desc: Fill it at water, then pour it on your crops to bring them on.

lore_skylands_temple.name: Old Book: The Queen of the Air

golden_feather.name: Golden Feather
golden_feather.desc: Carried, it makes every fall gentle (no fall damage while it's in your inventory).

valkyrie_lance.name: Valkyrie Lance
valkyrie_lance.desc: Light in the hand, and it sends things flying.

ember_crown.name: Ember Crown
ember_crown.desc: Fire hardly touches whoever wears it.

end_crystal.name: End Crystal
end_crystal.desc: Set four round the exit portal in The End to call the Ender Dragon back.

crushed_silver.name: Crushed Silver Ore
crushed_silver.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A crusher makes two (or three) from every ore.

crushed_mithril.name: Crushed Mithril Ore
crushed_mithril.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A crusher makes two (or three) from every ore.

crushed_adamantite.name: Crushed Adamantite Ore
crushed_adamantite.desc: Smelts into one ingot. A crusher makes two (or three) from every ore.

carriage.name: Carriage
carriage.desc: Set it down by a tamed horse or donkey and it hitches itself. Two seats (the front one drives) and a chest (sneak and use it with an empty hand).

tome_flames.name: Tome: Flames
tome_flames.desc: A gout of fire that burns everything in front of you. (Magic 6)

tome_chainlight.name: Tome: Chain Lightning
tome_chainlight.desc: Lightning leaps from the foe you look at to up to three more. (Magic 24)

tome_healother.name: Tome: Healing Hands
tome_healother.desc: Heals the nearest friend (or you, if nobody is near). (Magic 9)

tome_telekinesis.name: Tome: Telekinesis
tome_telekinesis.desc: Draws every dropped item within sixteen blocks to you. (Magic 7)

tome_featherfall.name: Tome: Feather Fall
tome_featherfall.desc: You fall as softly as a feather for a minute. (Magic 4)

tome_waterbreath.name: Tome: Water Breathing
tome_waterbreath.desc: Breathe under water for a minute and a half. (Magic 11)

tome_homeport.name: Tome: Home Teleport
tome_homeport.desc: Takes you to your bed or spawn point. Once every ten minutes. (Magic 1)

tome_lowalch.name: Tome: Low Alchemy
tome_lowalch.desc: Turns one item in your off hand into emeralds (60% of its worth). (Magic 21)

tome_nightsight.name: Tome: Night Eye
tome_nightsight.desc: See in the dark for two minutes. (Magic 5)

tome_invisibility.name: Tome: Invisibility
tome_invisibility.desc: Foes lose sight of you for half a minute. (Magic 30)

tome_drainlife.name: Tome: Drain Life
tome_drainlife.desc: Draws the life out of the foe you look at, healing you by half of it. (Magic 17)

tome_raiseskel.name: Tome: Raise Skeleton
tome_raiseskel.desc: Raises a skeleton to fight for you for a while. (Magic 26)

tome_entangle.name: Tome: Entangle
tome_entangle.desc: Roots hold every foe near where you look in place for a few seconds. (Magic 15)

key_bronze.name: Bronze Key
key_bronze.desc: Opens the bronze gate on the first floor of the Deep Halls.

key_silver.name: Silver Key
key_silver.desc: Opens the silver gate on the second floor of the Deep Halls.

key_gold.name: Gold Key
key_gold.desc: Opens the Lich King's hall, deep in the Deep Halls.

treasure_map.name: Treasure Map
treasure_map.desc: An old map with an X on it. Use it to see where; dig at the X.

firework_rocket.name: Firework Rocket
firework_rocket.desc: Use it on the ground to send it up in a burst of colour. Use it while gliding on elytra for a long boost forward.

white_firework_rocket.desc: Bursts in white. Use it on the ground to send it up, or while gliding on elytra for a boost.
